text:
Alex: Running a promote now but CI is failing on release/v2.1.0. integration-suite 42/42 failing on ubuntu-20 runner: wheel extract error. Blocking the change window.
Maya: saw this, looks like the new dependency wheel (libpako) built with manylinux_2_17, our runner expects manylinux_2_24. Failing during pip install - error: 'Invalid platform tag'.
Sam: deploy-bot shows promo paused: "promotion_status=paused reason=ci-failed". Can we pin to previous wheel? that's fastest.
Alex: paste of failing log:
```
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: ... wheel 'libpako-4.5.0-cp39-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.whl' is not compatible with the running platform
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "build.py", line 42, in <module>
    install_requirements()
```
Maya: quick options:
- pin libpako==4.4.2 and re-run CI (fast)
- rebuild wheel for manylinux_2_24 (slower, infra ops)
- manual promote skipping CI (not allowed for release policy)
Irene: agree pin; we should also add a release note to mention the temporary pin and follow up to re-enable newer wheel later.
Sam: I'll push a commit to release branch to pin in constraints.txt and kick the pipeline. @deploy-bot can you hold promos until CI green? :thumbsup:
release-bot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot (reason=ci-failed). Auto-unhold on manual-trigger when condition=ci:green or on schedule 2026-03-24T15:00:00Z.
ci-bot: Pipeline triggered: https://ci.example.com/builds/98531 — running integration-suite on ubuntu-20, ubuntu-22.
Alex: thanks. If ubuntu-22 passes and ubuntu-20 fails due to runner image, we may need to upgrade runner image instead of pin. But pin first to meet change window.
Maya: +1 pin now, open follow-up ticket to audit wheel build tags. I'll add to release notes draft.
Sam: commit pushed: `git commit -m "pin libpako to 4.4.2 for release v2.1.0" && git push origin release/v2.1.0` — CI green on ubuntu-20, merging in progress.
Irene: once merged, update release notes and schedule a post-release remediation run.
Alex: decision: pin dependency to unblock release, manual follow-up to rebuild wheel. Keeping promo paused until deploy-bot confirms green. :white_check_mark:
